landing.heroSubtitle: GPS-guided audio walking tours, museum guides and AI itineraries for independent travelers. Hands-free, in your language.
landing.step1Body: Browse curated cities and pick a tour that fits your time and mood.
landing.step2Body: Street walks or museum guides — free tours in full, paid tours with a free preview.
landing.step3Body: Follow the map stop by stop while the narration plays. Works offline too.
landing.scanTitle: Standing in front of a building?
landing.scanBody: Point your camera at any monument, church or landmark and get its story — you don't need to be in a museum.
landing.f1Body: Stories that play at the right moment
landing.f2Body: Exhibits explained in an engaging way
